Hobie Mirage iTrek Angler 10 Inflatable Fishing Kayak

The Mirage iTrek Angler 10 is Hobie's answer to the question every angler eventually asks: what if I could take a fully rigged fishing kayak anywhere? Built as an inflatable from the ground up, this kayak pairs Hobie's legendary MirageDrive 180 pedal system with Kick-Up Fin technology meaning logs, shallows, and rocky bottoms won't slow you down. Add the Hobie H-Rail with integrated patented RAM? Hand-Track, a stern designed for motor or PowerPole mounting, and reinforced construction throughout, and you have a complete fishing platform that packs into a rolling travel bag.

No dock access? No garage? No problem. Whether you're launching from a car trunk, a campsite, or a train station, the iTrek Angler 10 sets up in minutes and delivers the full Hobie fishing experience wherever the water is.

Specifications

Length 10 ft / 304 cm
Width 44" / 111 cm
Capacity 400 lbs / 181.4 kg
Fitted Hull Weight 33 lbs / 14.9 kg
Fully Rigged Weight 49 lbs / 22.2 kg
Bag Dimensions 33.5 x 24.6 x 15.75" / 85 x 62.5 x 40 cm
Color Olive
MSRP $2,799 USD
